meta.title: 02 Desktop Pet (2D / 3D)
meta.description: A desktop companion in the bottom-right corner: four characters (Onee / Genki / Chibi / Whaley) in both 2D illustration and real-time 3D figurine form. Click to pat, right-drag to orbit, drag anywhere; chat via local Ollama or the DeepSeek API. Switch form, size, quality and model in Settings.
